title: Publish current deployed draft to production

requirements.text: Promote the currently deployed draft (Draft Version 35) to the production (IC mainnet) environment, ensuring the production frontend and backend canisters are updated successfully.
acceptanceCriteria: The production app is accessible via the production frontend canister URL (https://<frontend-canister-id>.ic0.app).
The in-app build/version indicator in the footer shows a new build value after publish (different from the pre-publish value).
Service worker update flow functions in production: if an update is available, the update banner appears and reloading activates the latest assets without requiring an admin-only cache reset.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; introduce migration.mo only if state upgrades require it.
nonGoals: Adding new application features unrelated to production publishing.
Changing authentication providers (Internet Identity remains the only supported auth).
